key: GOTHITELLE: ...
en: GOTHITELLE: ...
ja: ゴチルゼル: ……

key: GOTHITELLE: -Be kind to the wounded ward.-
en: GOTHITELLE: -Be kind to the wounded ward.-
ja: ゴチルゼル: ―傷ついた者にやさしくあれ。―

key: GOTHITELLE: -So, the young one wishes to journey out into the world.-
en: GOTHITELLE: -So, the young one wishes to journey out into the world.-
ja: ゴチルゼル: ―さて、幼き者は世界へと旅立つことを望んでいるようだ。―

key: -She is ill-suited to the life our family leads.-
en: -She is ill-suited to the life our family leads.-
ja: ―この子は、我らが一族の暮らしには向いておらぬ。―

key: -Take her if you wish.-
en: -Take her if you wish.-
ja: ―望むならば、連れて行くがよい。―

key: -Watch over her.-
en: -Watch over her.-
ja: ―どうか見守ってやってほしい。―

key: -Beyond these walls lies reality's most contentious tantrum.-
en: -Beyond these walls lies reality's most contentious tantrum.-
ja: ―この壁の向こうには、現実というものの、最も荒々しい駄々がある。―

key: GOTHITELLE: -We will remain here in tranquility in solemn anticipation of the future yet-to-come.-
en: GOTHITELLE: -We will remain here in tranquility in solemn anticipation of the future yet-to-come.-
ja: ゴチルゼル: ―我らはこの地に留まり、静けさの中で、まだ来ぬ未来を厳かに待つ。―

key: -It seems the room has been cleared. I thank you for your help, human.-
en: -It seems the room has been cleared. I thank you for your help, human.-
ja: ―この部屋は片付いたようだ。手伝いに感謝する、人間よ。―

key: -We have little to offer in return, but you may take this.-
en: -We have little to offer in return, but you may take this.-
ja: ―お返しできるものはわずかだが、これを受け取るがよい。―

key: GOTHITELLE: -May it light the way to your void- kissed fate.-
en: GOTHITELLE: -May it light the way to your void- kissed fate.-
ja: ゴチルゼル: ―それが、そなたの――虚無に触れられし運命を、照らす光となりますように。―

key: -There are just a few pieces left now.-
en: -There are just a few pieces left now.-
ja: ―残りは、あとわずかだ。―

key: -The room is looking somewhat clearer now, but there's still much to do.-
en: -The room is looking somewhat clearer now, but there's still much to do.-
ja: ―部屋は多少片付いてきたが、まだやるべきことは多い。―

key: -There is still a lot of debris remaining.-
en: -There is still a lot of debris remaining.-
ja: ―がれきはまだ、かなり残っている。―

key: -If you were to help me collect the rubbish and stray books, I would be much appreciative.-
en: -If you were to help me collect the rubbish and stray books, I would be much appreciative.-
ja: ―ごみと散らばった本を集める手伝いをしてくれるなら、大変ありがたい。―

key: -Trainer, you can understand me, correct?-
en: -Trainer, you can understand me, correct?-
ja: ―トレーナーよ、そなたには我が言葉が分かるのだろう?―

key: -This library was our home. It still is, and always will be.-
en: -This library was our home. It still is, and always will be.-
ja: ―この図書室は、我らの住処であった。今もそうであり、これからも、ずっとそうであろう。―

key: -In this shape it is hardly a suitable place for my daughters.-
en: -In this shape it is hardly a suitable place for my daughters.-
ja: ―この有り様では、我が娘たちにふさわしい場所とは到底言えぬ。―
